Top concept

24-Day Schedule

Phase 1 gets every shot present, even if rough. Phase 2 concentrates all remaining iteration on the shots that carry the weight. Without the split, iteration cost runs the project over before the ending exists.

Daily Log

Track the acceptance rate. If it runs far below 1.5%, the problem is upstream — usually the assets. Stop generating and fix the asset.

DateGensKeptRateNote

Concepts

Ranked by the harness. A jury of three converges on the film nobody objects to before it converges on the film someone loves — so a concept with no weak axis beats one with a peak and a hole.

Wargame

Score a concept twice: as a short film, and as a thing these three specific people will watch on a specific afternoon in late September. Those are different questions.

Ideas Inbox

Drop ideas in any state — a sentence, an image, a feeling. Write it badly. Promote the ones with legs into scored concepts.

The single source of truth. One row per generation. The two gates below catch errors that are invisible until the timeline.

Prompt Builder

The Hell Grind block scaffold. The model has no memory between generations — consistency is not a setting, it is repetition. Descriptors go in verbatim, every time, never shortened.

Geo spatial layout — locked per scene

Positive locks

Fill the blocks and press Build prompt.

The Jury

All three independently want the same film. That is not a compromise between three tastes — it is a genuine intersection, and it happens to be what AI video is currently best at.

What loses

The modal entry: a 3-minute montage, 50+ four-second clips, constant camera movement, orange-and-teal, trailer score, portentous VO, no character you could name afterwards. There will be thousands. Their notes would read:

Catmull — "Extremely accomplished images. I could not tell you what happened or to whom."
Papamichael — "Every shot is lit from everywhere. There's no time of day. Nobody made a choice."
Anderson — "It's cut so fast I never worked out where anyone was standing."

Model Routing

Only two models exceed 15 seconds. If the rules require all generation inside Cinema Studio, the ceiling drops to 12 and the anchor takes must be built by continuation chaining instead.
